title: Pubnet ledger 50574257 (protocol 20): a wasm upload whose ContractCodeEntry has ext v0, before cost inputs existed
why: Contract code uploaded under protocol 20 is stored with ContractCodeEntry.ext v0; protocol 21 (CAP-0054) added ext v1 with ContractCodeCostInputs, and entries written before it keep v0 for good. Readers that assume every code entry carries cost inputs, or that only ever saw generated entries (all v1), fail on this real upload.
notes: Apply index 697 of 698 uploads wasm ce6a090a029f7a68990f183059b8967a7d477555a2211a5d1aa13641bc6837db. Found by xdrcheck-corpus mine (arm ContractCodeEntryExt::v0). The lake object was regenerated by core 23.0.1, so TransactionMeta is v4 although the ledger is protocol 20; the code entry itself is ledger state and keeps ext v0. Header hash recomputed from the header and every transaction hash from its envelope at capture.
